dialogue.en: Welcome to the Fire Gym of Percentile! I am so happy you came!
dialogue.he: ברוך הבא למכון האש של פרסנטייל! אני כל כך שמחה שבאת!

dialogue.en: There are 5 rooms. Each room has 5 helpers. Each one teaches you a trick and gives an answer.

dialogue.he: רק עוזר אחד צודק. עלה על החץ שליד העוזר שצודק!

dialogue.en: A wrong arrow brings you back here. No worries — mistakes help us learn!

dialogue.en: Trick: 100% means ALL of it. 100% of 8 is 8!

dialogue.en: My answer: all 20 found the leader!

dialogue.he: אם אתה חושב שאני צודק — עלה על החץ שלידי!

dialogue.en: A good trainer, like a good fire, needs 3 things: fuel, air and heat. Show me yours!

postBattleDialogue.en: Take this badge. You have earned it with your head and your heart.
